definition.survival_combinatorial: frac of doc d's selected slots that NO later document re-selects
definition.survival_numeric_1e-3: frac of doc d's written (head,slot) value vectors whose relative change from end-of-doc-d to end-of-run is < 1e-3
definition.write_retained_fraction: <V_final - V_before_d, V_after_d - V_before_d> / ||V_after_d - V_before_d||^2 on doc d's slots (1 = the whole increment survives). UNBOUNDED above -- >1 means later writes moved the same slots further in the same direction.
definition.value_cosine_final_vs_after_d: mean cos(V_final, V_after_d) over doc d's written (head,slot) value vectors
definition.subsequent_change_over_own_write: ||V_final - V_after_d|| / ||V_after_d - V_before_d|| -- how big the later documents' net change to d's slots is, relative to the change d itself made
definition.mean_later_writes_per_own_slot: average number of LATER documents that re-select each of doc d's slots

definition.spearman: rank correlation between two documents' per-layer slot scores (ranking_info.tf, 511 slots), averaged over all 120 document pairs
definition.overlap_with_doc_independent_top32: |top-32 of the ACROSS-DOCUMENT MEAN score  &  doc d's own top-32| / 32 -- 1.0 means the selection carries no document-specific information
